answer: Each new key is derived from the previous one through a one-way function, and the previous key is deleted immediately after derivation. Even if an attacker steals the current key, they cannot rewind to past keys, so text sealed under earlier keys stays unreadable forever. The system restores a terrace only after its credentials survive the challenge. A jetty and a velvet may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
